C0779.title: Lanzhou University Server Compromised by Remote Cryptomining Malware with Lateral Spread
C0779.summary: In May 2026, cyber police in Lanzhou, Gansu found anomalies during a routine inspection of a local university system server. Investigation found that the server had been remotely implanted with cryptocurrency mining malware that spread laterally to other office devices. Public security authorities imposed an administrative penalty for failure to fulfill cybersecurity protection obligations, ordered rectification within a time limit, and the malware was removed.
